title: Welcome to Somewhere
text: The path from Sunken King's Throne brought us here. I think. The first portal dropped us beside the exact same portal we entered through, except Glimmer's crown was suddenly on MY head. We tried again. Now there are two crowns. I have decided Astral Nexus is going to be difficult.

title: Stars Underfoot
text: There are stars beneath the path here. Not reflections. Actual little lights drifting under my boots. I called out the name of a constellation from Moonlit Reef and three of them lit up. Glimmer chimed at another cluster and somehow got SEVEN. Why is Glimmer better at everything?

title: Moonlit Reef, Upside Down
text: Found a piece of Moonlit Reef floating above us today. Coral, glowing water, tiny reef fish—the whole thing. Upside down. The water refuses to fall. Glimmer immediately flew up to investigate. I stayed below like the responsible explorer I have apparently become.

title: The Folded Mile
text: We walked straight ahead for one hundred steps and somehow arrived behind our own campsite. I tried again while counting VERY carefully. Same result. Glimmer flew ten feet to the left and reached the destination immediately. I refuse to accept this as valid navigation.

title: Please Ignore Future Me
text: Met another version of myself through a portal today. She pointed at a glowing switch and said, 'Don't touch that.' I asked if SHE touched it. She said, 'That's not important.' We both stared at each other for a while. I did not touch the switch. Character growth.

title: Starfall Through the Window
text: A tear opened in the air and Starfall Trench was on the other side. I could see the falling stars, except they were going UP. One little fragment slipped through and floated around Glimmer like it remembered us. I waved goodbye before the window closed. Weirdly nice seeing the place again.

title: Memory Reef
text: The coral here grows memories instead of branches. One showed Moonlit Reef. Another showed Whispering Kelp Forest. Another replayed Glimmer stealing my captain's hat in Leviathan's Wake. GLIMMER claims that is not what happened. The magical memory archive has spoken.

title: Portal Etiquette
text: Found an old Fae inscription that says you're supposed to greet portals before asking where they lead. So I tried it. 'Hello, portal! Where do you go?' It opened directly underneath me. Apparently manners are important but not necessarily rewarded.

title: The Missing Minute
text: Every clock here skips the same minute. I stood beside one waiting to see what happens. One moment it was 3:14. Then it was 3:16 and Glimmer was wearing a tiny paper hat I absolutely did not make. Neither of us remembers the missing minute. Glimmer refuses to surrender the hat.

title: The Very Important Rock
text: Found a completely ordinary rock on a pedestal surrounded by orbiting stars and enough cosmic light to make it look extremely important. Someone had drawn a face on it. I named him Gerald. Glimmer bowed. We have no idea what Gerald does. Gerald may do nothing. Please respect Gerald.

title: Hall of Other Shizukis
text: A mirror hall showed dozens of versions of me today. Knight Shizuki. Queen Shizuki. Shizuki with WAY too many berries. One had a giant mustache. One waved before I did. We left that mirror alone. Glimmer spent most of the visit trying to find a version of itself wearing a crown.

title: Architecture Has Given Up
text: We found a tower being built from the roof DOWN. The top floor exists. The middle exists sometimes. The foundation appears only after you enter. I tried drawing it. My sketch rearranged itself. I have officially been defeated by architecture.

title: The Other Astral Sea
text: A portal opened onto another Astral Sea today. I couldn't see Moonlit Reef anywhere. The stars were different. The currents were different. For a second I wondered if another Shizuki was standing somewhere over there looking back at us. Then the portal closed. I hope she's doing okay.

title: The Berry Incident
text: I found dozens of berries suspended perfectly still in zero gravity. Naturally, I wrote 'I HAVE A PLAN.' Glimmer immediately left the area. The plan was excellent. The plan also no longer exists. I will not be answering questions.

title: Gravity Choir
text: The room changes gravity whenever it plays a musical note. Low note: floor. Middle note: wall. High note: ceiling. VERY high note: somewhere I don't think geometry approves of. I wrote 'THE HIGH NOTE IS A LIAR' for future explorers. You're welcome.

title: Six Places at Once
text: Today I stood somewhere that looked like every region we've visited at the same time. Moonlit water floated beside Starfall stone. Whispering Kelp grew around a Leviathan rib. A royal lantern from the Sunken Kingdom drifted between them. I didn't know whether to draw a map or apologize to reality.

title: Glimmer Found Glimmer
text: We found a tiny constellation that follows travelers around. It followed Glimmer immediately. Glimmer flew left. Stars went left. Glimmer spun. Stars spun. Glimmer now has a glowing space-friend. I have apparently been demoted again.

title: The Door Argument
text: Two magical doors were arguing about which one was the entrance. Door One said, 'ME.' Door Two said, 'LIAR.' I wrote, 'I picked the third one.' There were only two doors when I wrote that. Ten seconds later a third door appeared. I would like credit for discovering doors through spite.

title: The Sunken Second Location
text: Somehow my old Crownmarket stall is HERE. In the Nexus. Same counter. Same sign. Same lack of merchandise. I added 'SECOND LOCATION.' Glimmer is back in management. Business remains catastrophically slow.

title: Yesterday's Campsite
text: We made camp somewhere that cannot decide WHEN our campsite exists. One second the blanket is new. Next second it's covered in dust. Then it's gone. Then Glimmer is already asleep on it even though I haven't unpacked it yet. I have decided bedtime is now whenever reality says it is.

title: First Light
text: The Nexus became quiet this morning. Completely quiet. No arguing portals. No sideways gravity. No future versions of me giving terrible advice. Just the Astral Sea beneath a sunrise that seemed to stretch forever. Glimmer sat beside me. We stayed longer than we needed to.

title: The Infinite Slide
text: Found an enormous glowing slope disappearing through three portals. I wrote 'DO IT' beside the entrance for completely responsible reasons. Three portals, one gravity reversal, and an extremely undignified landing later, I wrote another message at the bottom: 'Worth it.'

title: The Room That Forgot Me
text: There's a room here that resets whenever I look away. Move a chair? Reset. Move a table? Reset. Except the things I touched stay moved. After thirty minutes I had built an elaborate path through the entire room. Glimmer simply flew over everything. I hate being the one without wings.

title: Wrong-Way Map
text: I tried making a Nexus map today. It began with 'THIS WAY!' Then 'WRONG WAY.' Then 'ACTUALLY THIS WAY.' Then 'HOW.' Eventually I found myself standing in a room I had already mapped three times. Final cartographic note: 'WHY IS THIS ROOM BACK.'

title: The Festival Came With Us
text: We heard music today. Then royal lanterns appeared between the stars, followed by one of the game booths from the King's Festival. It recognized me immediately. Apparently my archery score is STILL three. I would like to formally complain that reality itself is preserving slander.

title: Something Took a Bite
text: Parts of time are missing in one corridor. I took one step and suddenly I had taken four. A pebble fell and skipped straight from my hand to the floor. Glimmer chimed once and the echo arrived before the sound. I don't know what's eating the moments here. I also don't intend to feed it.

title: The Shizuki Problem
text:
The Nexus started replaying old magical copies of me. One ran left. One ran right. One argued with a portal. One sat down. One confidently pointed somewhere every other copy immediately avoided. I watched all of them for several minutes before realizing something awful.

This is what traveling with me looks like.

Glimmer has been incredibly patient.

title: The Astral Sea in a Bottle
text:
We found a huge glass-like sphere today. Inside were tiny versions of Moonlit Reef, Starfall Trench, Whispering Kelp Forest, Leviathan's Wake, Sunken King's Throne, and the Nexus itself. Little currents connected all six.

I stared at it for a long time.

We really came all that way.

Glimmer tapped the glass and immediately pointed beyond the edge of the miniature map.

Of course you did.

title: Past the Edge of the Map
text:
There are currents leading away from the Nexus toward every place we've traveled. I recognized them all eventually.

But there's another one.

No Moonlit glow. No falling stars. No whispering kelp. No Leviathan bones. No royal lanterns.

Just a current disappearing past the edge of every chart I own.

I wrote one thing beside it.

'Okay... this part isn't on my map.'

Glimmer has been staring down that path all day.

title: The First Journey Ends
text:
We reached the Heart of the Astral Sea today.

At least, that's what I'm calling it.

For once the Nexus stopped fighting with itself. Moonlit Reef water drifted through the air beneath falling Starfall lights. Whispering Kelp curled around an ancient Leviathan bone. Lanterns from Sunken King's Throne floated among the constellations. Every place we'd traveled was there at once.

I found pieces of our journey everywhere.

The first terrible map I drew.

A little star like the ones Glimmer used to sit on.

One of my arrows.

A berry container.

A fake mustache.

For a while, Glimmer and I just sat there.

Moonlit Reef felt so far away when we started. I didn't know anything about Starfall Trench. I didn't know forests could gossip. I didn't know bones could be big enough to use as bridges. I definitely didn't know I'd become the undefeated champion of a pastry-eating contest.

Okay. Technically there may not have been another contestant.

Still counts.

I used to think every path needed a destination before you followed it.

I don't anymore.

Because beyond the Nexus, there's another current.

No name on the map.

No destination.

No idea what's waiting out there.

Glimmer is already floating beside it.

Of course Glimmer is.

So I packed the berries.

Folded the map.

And followed.

The Astral Sea is bigger than I thought.

Good.

I wasn't finished exploring anyway~
